'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Jon Hollingsworth DS notepad list''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jon Hollingsworth]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Transcription note: Not a deck form - a handwritten notepad list in heavy shorthand with xN counts. Every item is written as it appears on the notepad, unlinked; the card count cannot be confirmed. Cleanup (expanding shorthand to card titles) is left for later.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' My Lord Is That Legal...
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.1]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
